versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the weibo-scraper-api skill.
- Provides 31 endpoints for extracting structured Weibo data: user profiles, posts, comments, likes, reposts, keyword and content searches, hot-search and ranking boards, and channel feeds.
- Each endpoint returns structured JSON; every API call costs 1 credit.
- Includes examples for Python and curl usage.
- Requires an API key (SCAVIO_API_KEY) from scavio.dev for authentication.
- Offers detailed setup, identifier usage, pagination, and error handling guidance.
